### Observed differences

- Five activities — A22, A31, A32, A37 and A38 — ran in every trace in the earlier window (participation 100 in 100, at most once per trace), but in the later window each runs in only about 50 in 100 traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- A20's successor changed almost completely: earlier its outgoing transitions went to A37 (about 28 in 100), A38 (26), A32 (25) and A31 (22); in the later window about 995 in 1000 go directly to A23, and A23 now follows A20 immediately (one step) in essentially all traces instead of five steps later. [DIR001, LAG001]
- A21's routing changed: earlier it always led to A22; in the later window about half of its outgoing transitions still go to A22, while the rest go to A31, A32, A37 or A38. [DIR002]
- A22 and each of the four activities became mutually exclusive: earlier each such pair co-occurred in 100 in 100 traces (block activity before A22); in the later window they co-occur in essentially no trace (about 0.5 in 100), each appearing without the other in about half the traces. [REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- When the four activities run in the later window, their surroundings flipped: earlier they preceded A21, A23 and A22; in the later window they follow A21 and A23, precede A26, and lead to A26 rather than to A23. They still run together as a group (co-occurring in about 50 in 100 traces, with neither present in the other half) and in a mixed mutual order in both windows. [REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006]
- The two branches after A21 are also visible in distances: A21 reaches A26 two steps later in about half of the later traces (via A22) and five steps later in the other half (via the four activities), where earlier it was always two steps; the four activities, when they run, sit later in the trace (mean relative position about 0.40 earlier versus about 0.58 later). [LAG006, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009]
- The elapsed time between consecutive completions of A42 and A43 roughly doubled, from a median of about 1.0 hour to about 2.0 hours. [TWAIT001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the flow was rerouted around the four-activity block A31/A32/A37/A38 and that this block became an alternative to A22. In the earlier window every trace ran A20, then the four activities in a mixed order, then A23, A21, A22 and A26; in the later window A20 leads directly to A23, and after A21 the trace runs either A22 or the four activities — essentially never both, roughly 50 in 100 traces each — with the block, when it runs, flowing into A26.

The successor changes at A20 and A21 are observed directly, as is the mutual exclusivity between A22 and each block activity; the order relations place the block after A21/A23 and before A26 in the later window; the participation drops to about half for all five activities match a 50/50 branch; and the A21-to-A26 distance split of two versus five steps matches the two branches [DIR001, DIR002, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, LAG001, LAG006]. With 61 evidence items against roughly 0.74 expected for an unchanged process, sampling variation cannot account for the pattern as a whole. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that the aggregate 50/50 split reflects two systematically different case populations in the later window rather than a per-case routing choice; the indicators are aggregate and cannot distinguish these. A few lag items rest on a single later-window observation and were not relied upon [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010].

Other differences: the elapsed time between consecutive completions of A42 and A43 roughly doubled (median about 1.0 hour to about 2.0 hours), a timing change not covered by the routing hypothesis above. [TWAIT001]

- Screening: 149 units tested, 0.74 items expected without change.

61 items vs 0.74 expected without change — that's many times larger, so chance as a whole cannot explain it. So we move past the screening comparison and judge by directness, consistency, and ability to rule out competing explanations.

Now let me understand the behavioural story.

OCC items:
- OCC001: A22 — before: participation 1.0 (in all 200 traces), mean 1.0 per trace; after: participation 0.5 (in 100 of 200 traces), mean 0.5. So A22 went from always occurring to occurring in about half the traces.
- OCC002: A31 — before participation 1.0, after 0.505 (101/200).
- OCC003: A32 — same, 0.505.
- OCC004: A37 — same, 0.505.

So five activities (A22, A31, A32, A37, A38) each went from occurring in every trace to occurring in about half the traces. This looks like a new branch: in the later window, about half the traces skip these activities.

DIR items:
- DIR001: source A20. Before: outgoing transitions to A37 (0.28), A31 (0.22), A38 (0.255), A32 (0.245). After: A23 (0.995), A31 (0.005). So A20 now almost always leads to A23, whereas before it led to one of A31/A32/A37/A38.

REL items — many. Let me group:

REL001-REL005: pairs (A20, X) for X in {A22, A31, A32, A37, A38}. Before: co-occurrence 1.0, A_before_B 1.0 (A20 before X always). After: co-occurrence ~0.5, A_only 0.5 (A20 occurs without X), A_before_B ~0.5. So in the later window, about half the traces have A20 without X.

- A21 → A22 only half the time; otherwise → one of {A31, A32, A37, A38} (DIR002 after).
- The four activities now occur in only ~50% of traces (OCC002-005), and when they occur, they come after A21 (REL007-010: A21 before X in the after window) and before A26 (REL021-024: X before A26). Their positions moved later (POS006-009: mean ~0.40 → ~0.58).

- DIR003-006: the four activities no longer lead to A23 (A23 component dropped to 0), instead lead to A26 (new component ~0.22-0.28). Consistent with block now running after A21 and leading to A26 instead of A23.

So the structural change: a branch was introduced (or the routing changed) such that in the later window, about half the cases skip the block {A31, A32, A37, A38} between A20 and A23 (A20 → A23 directly), and after A21 the process either executes A22 (as before) or, in about half the cases, executes the block {A31, A32, A37, A38} instead of A22, with the block then leading to A26.
